doc.name: AgenticWebScore
doc.instructions: Call scan_site with a domain to measure it, or get_score to read a stored scan record without a new scan. get_report returns the record as markdown, or one check of it. list_checks lists the scored and unscored checks of the rubric. New scans are limited to 10 per client per minute and 3 running at once.

tools.name: scan_site
tools.title: Scan a site
tools.description: Scan a public domain and return the full scan record: score and its two parts, level, per-check status, evidence, and fingerprint. A stored record younger than 6 hours is returned without a new scan, unless fresh is true. New scans are limited to 10 per client per minute and 3 running at once. A new scan runs for up to 60 s. If the call times out first, the scan still finishes and is stored, and a later call returns it.

target.description: Domain or URL to scan, for example "example.com".

fresh.description: Scan again instead of returning a stored record younger than 6 hours (default false).

tools.name: get_score
tools.title: Read a stored score
tools.description: Return the stored scan record for a host. It starts no scan. A host with no stored record is answered with an error that says so.

host.description: Domain, host:port, or origin of a scanned site, for example "example.com".

tools.name: list_checks
tools.title: List the checks
tools.description: List the 60 checks of rubric v0.9.1 across 5 dimensions, each with its kind, module, dimension, and rationale. A scored check also has a part, a tier and a weight. An unscored check earns 0 points.

tools.name: get_report
tools.title: Read a report
tools.description: Return the markdown status report of a host's stored scan record, or one check of it by check id. It starts no scan.

host.description: Domain, host:port, or origin of a scanned site, for example "example.com".

check.description: A check id, for example "llms-txt". Leave it out for the whole report.
